_comment: Optional extra providers for failover. Copy to llm_pool.json and put each api_key_env in backend/.env. priority 1 = rotates with the main models, 2 = backup only (use 2 for slow hosts). timeout_s = give up and fail over after this many seconds. Entries without a key are skipped; models without an allowed open-source licence (ALLOWED_MODEL_LICENSES) are dropped. Check each provider's free-tier terms first.
